prompt: Why does the man say, "Not yet"?

options.text: He wants to stop production first.
options.whyZh: 手持讀數正常，因此可繼續生產。

options.text: He has already ordered a sensor.
He wants to check a simpler cause first.
options.zh: 他想先檢查較簡單的原因。
options.whyZh: 他要先排除接線鬆動，避免不必要地更換感測器。

options.text: He is waiting for a new contractor.
options.whyZh: 有既定承包商來訪，沒有更換承包商。

explanationZh: 他要先排除接線鬆動，避免不必要地更換感測器。
evidence: I want to rule out a loose connection before we order another part.
